document.abstract: A degree of standardization of super-8 cartridge sound films has evolved in response to the purchasing power of the Department of Defense. The DOD elected in 1970 to purchase equipment only according to a standard (MIL STD 1354) based on three ANSI (American National Standards Institute) standards for super-8 film with magnetic sound and plus 18-frame sound sync. Military programs for recruiting and training were initiated to use new “MIL-STD compatible” equipment, for which Fairchild has supplied an engineering program.
